## Formal {.unnumbered}
$$
    BC_{AB} = 1 - \frac{2 \sum_{i=1}^S min(N_i^A, N_i^B)}{\sum_{i=1}^S (N_i^A + N_i^B)}
$${#eq-bray-curtis}
